Title: Generally Available: Azure Chaos Studio Now in Germany West Central Region

Body.Content:
Azure Chaos Studio is a managed service that uses chaos engineering to help measure, understand, and improve cloud application and service resilience. Azure Chaos Studio Resource Targeting is now available in Germany West Central region. For complete list of regions, see list of regions Azure Chaos Studio is available.

Learn more.
